name: Operations {OS}
tagline: Process diagnosis and work simplification before automation.

commands.name: /ops-scope
commands.summary: Set and agree the process boundary: first trigger, last output, roles.

commands.name: /ops-interview
commands.summary: Interview every role that touches the work, including for the workarounds.

commands.name: /ops-observe
commands.summary: Record a real run with timings, with consent.

commands.name: /ops-map
commands.summary: Build the current-state map with handoffs, waits, decisions and rework loops.

commands.name: /ops-measure
commands.summary: Put numbers on each step, marking unknowns as unknown.

commands.name: /ops-waste
commands.summary: Separate waste from controls, each with its evidence.

commands.name: /ops-simplify
commands.summary: Run the ladder in order: eliminate, simplify, standardise, delegate, automate.

commands.name: /ops-exceptions
commands.summary: Enumerate the abnormal runs and their rate.

commands.name: /ops-target
commands.summary: Design the target operating model with its controls and exception paths.

commands.name: /ops-readiness
commands.summary: Issue the automation readiness verdict and assemble the handoff packet.

requires_human_approval_for: removing a step that touches money, compliance, safety or a client commitment
publishing a current-state map that names individuals and their timings
declaring a process ready for automation
